summary: Documentation-only change aligning the builder, fixer, and verifier declarations with the already-implemented evidence-ref protocol (refs/forest/v1/{request,checks,verdict}/<sha> with request.json/checks.json/verdict.json). Verified against publish.go, publish_verdict.go, and polls_evidence.go: the Kernel writes create-only evidence refs with the required committer identities and, on approve, runs configured checks then fast-forwards master in the same atomic push; the selection steps match the poller's evidence-ref selection and identity validation. All four configured checks pass (build, vet, test, secrets), origin/master is the direct parent of the revision, and the selected SHA still fast-forwards cleanly. Two minor non-blocking notes remain: builder agent.md step 5/8 retain legacy 'review-request note'/'git notes' wording, and fixer agent.md step 2 no longer pre-filters verdict==changes at selection (deferred to step 6), which can cause a spurious stop on an approved branch but cannot cause a wrong repair.
